scope: Independent integration/results review of run.py, analyze.py, response_probe.py, experiment README, provenance README/summary/response probe; accepted P1 and code review premises inspected. Root README, PROJECT_STATE, final handoff and receipt changes are outside scope.

findings.subject: Prior once, common support and truth separation
findings.detail: Direct uses original prior once plus ordered raw likelihood; each compressed objective uses original prior once plus one joint QR residual. The R2 gate gives direct the same physical path/public log-shape box. All fields share fixed public center and starts; generator truth outputs are discarded, not passed to objectives, start selection, transport or proposed-load forecasts. Sensitivity rows are feature representations of existing observations, not pseudomeasurements.

findings.subject: Chronology, source identity and original evidence preservation
findings.detail: Independent pilot and full runs regenerate identical observation hashes for three loads. Registered source identities (92 checks across the runs), protocol and new C/P1 artifact identities match current sources. All 1872 query-arm records, 42 complete arm fit dictionaries including 84 attempts, and 72 factor/state arrays repeat exactly. Existing one-hour direct/R2_H2/R5_H2/R5_H7 controls retain all 12 selected charts exactly and their statuses. New results reside in separate runs; archived rejected class/tests remain bound by original review hashes.

findings.subject: Status retention and solver selection
findings.detail: Each arm retains both public attempts; minimum-cost converged attempt is selected when present. Pilot has 20/21 converged and full has 19/21. Pilot Hermite rest and full direct/Hermite rest remain unresolved. No fit-to-reference/forecast comparisons are emitted when candidate or reference is unresolved. Six domain-exit witnesses refuse every field. Numerical stops are not interpreted as physical exclusion.

findings.subject: Full covariance SOC and sampled voltage readouts
findings.detail: Origin root C=L*chol(P)^(-T) remains full joint. Direct and compressed transport propagate D*C; endpoint SOC uses its entire row norm, and forecast SD uses entire J*D*C row. Independent covariance quadratic-form calculation checks 156 SOC scalars and 378 forecast scalars. Same-anchor reference uses the direct precision at that candidate; fitted-reference ratio uses converged direct fit. Read-only rest60 and pulse120mA10s/rest30 forecasts evaluate sampled physical voltage from endpoint state with static parameters and full correlated covariance; no future observation assimilation, truth scoring, continuous minimum guarantee or calibrated coverage claim.

findings.subject: Table arithmetic and locality mechanism
findings.detail: Compact analyzer and mechanism probe repeat byte-for-byte. All six table rows agree with signed Q=100*expm1(logQcandidate-logQdirect) and maximum over the two compressed-transport task RMS values converted from mV to uV. Taylor Q improvement is 12.3352x for multiscale; forecast ratios are 8.97358x/30.8202x. Active direct RC log offsets have maximum magnitude 0.132404. Active gradient counts are Taylor 62/40, Hermite 48/54, cubic 48/54. Public probe central/anchor identities and off-center regression figures match saved probe.

findings.subject: No-promotion interpretation and storage
findings.detail: Rest pilot regression (Taylor 461.994uV versus R2 48.1867uV), unresolved Hermite rest, off-center Taylor defect and H2 width distortion are prominently retained. Embedded Taylor SOC width ratios 0.524554 same-anchor/0.583149 fitted-reference versus H7 0.999432/0.999413 support unresolved uncertainty issue. Factor/lower subtotal arithmetic is Taylor 4760/5168 B, Hermite and cubic 6560/7016 B, R5_H2 11024/11576 B. Dense host roots and omitted prior/tables/metadata/scratch/platform resources preclude firmware claim. Finite correlated synthetic examples do not establish physical coverage, aging, lifetime uniform bounds, target performance or a production replacement.

import json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from experiments.rc_sensitivity_basis_001.basis import SensitivityField
from experiments.response_basis_attribution_001.basis import BasisField
from experiments.hysteresis_mixed_completion_001.rc_control import RC5Control
from experiments.hysteresis_refinement_001.field import MixedField,transported
from experiments.foster_campaign_001.compact import StimulusStream
from experiments.foster_campaign_001.coordinates import prior
from experiments.foster_feedback_001.estimator import Model
from experiments.slow_likelihood_diagnostic_001.numerics import Exact
from experiments.hysteresis_mixed_completion_001.run import future_tasks
from experiments.foster_campaign_001.backend import identity
root=Path.cwd();base=root/'experiments/rc_sensitivity_basis_001'
counts=dict(replayed_fit_records=0,replayed_query_arm_records=0,replayed_factor_arrays=0,source_bindings=0,SOC_scalar_checks=0,forecast_scalar_checks=0,attempts=0)
maxerr={};statuses={}
def near(label,x,y):
 x=np.asarray(x);y=np.asarray(y);err=float(np.max(abs(x-y)));maxerr[label]=max(maxerr.get(label,0),err)
 assert np.allclose(x,y,rtol=3e-7,atol=2e-9),(label,x,y,err)
for tag in ['pilot','full']:
 old=base/(tag+'001');new=Path('/tmp/rc-controls-review-r1-'+tag)
 reg=json.loads((old/'registration.json').read_text());config=reg['config'];center=reg['center'];mean,L=prior(config)
 for name,want in reg['source']['sources'].items():
  assert identity(root/name)==want,name;counts['source_bindings']+=1
 for name,want in reg['new_artifacts'].items():assert identity(root/name)==want
 assert identity(root/'specifications/rc_sensitivity_basis_001/README.md')==reg['protocol']
 fields={'R2_H2':BasisField(config,center,old/'response/response.so'),
  'Taylor2_H2':SensitivityField(config,center,old/'response_taylor2/response.so','taylor2'),
  'Hermite3_H2':SensitivityField(config,center,old/'response_hermite3/response.so','hermite3'),
  'R3_H2':SensitivityField(config,center,old/'response/response.so','chebyshev3'),
  'R5_H2':RC5Control(config,center,old/'response/response.so','td2'),
  'R5_H7':MixedField(config,center,1.,7,old/'response/response.so')}
 model=Model(old/'backend_c/estimator.so',config)
 for load in ['rest','multiscale','embedded']:
  a=json.loads((old/(load+'.json')).read_text());b=json.loads((new/(load+'.json')).read_text());p=a['prefixes'][0];q=b['prefixes'][0]
  assert p['observation_sha256']==q['observation_sha256']
  assert p['probes']==q['probes'];counts['replayed_query_arm_records']+=len(p['probes'])*6
  assert len(p['probes'])==52 and sum(x['selection']=='public' for x in p['probes'])==51
  for probe in p['probes']:
   if probe['selection']!='public':assert all(v['status']=='unsupported' for v in probe['arms'].values())
  for name,v in p['fits']['arms'].items():
   assert v==q['fits']['arms'][name],(tag,load,name);counts['replayed_fit_records']+=1;counts['attempts']+=len(v['attempts'])
   statuses[tag+'/'+load+'/'+name]=v['status']
   valid=[(i,z) for i,z in enumerate(v['attempts']) if z['status']=='converged']
   if valid:assert v['selected_start']==min(valid,key=lambda iz:iz[1]['diagnostic']['cost'])[0]
   if v['status']!='converged' or p['fits']['arms']['direct']['status']!='converged':assert v['fit_comparison']['status']=='unresolved_candidate_or_reference_fit' and 'forecasts' not in v
  n=p['records'];f=np.load(old/f'{load}_{n}_factors.npz');g=np.load(new/f'{load}_{n}_factors.npz')
  for key in f.files:assert np.array_equal(f[key],g[key]);counts['replayed_factor_arrays']+=1
  for name,field in fields.items():field.state=f[name+'_state'].copy();field.root=f[name+'_root'].copy()
  fixture=json.loads(Path(a['baseline_result']['path']).read_text());recipe=fixture['recipe'];stream=StimulusStream(config,recipe['cell'],recipe['case'],recipe['settings'])
  chunks=[]
  while stream.index<n:
   ob,_,_=stream.read(min(1024,n-stream.index));chunks.append(ob)
  obs=np.vstack(chunks);assert hashlib.sha256(obs.astype('<f8').tobytes()).hexdigest()==p['observation_sha256']
  exact=Exact(model,obs,mean,L,chunk=4096);data={}
  for name,v in p['fits']['arms'].items():
   fit=v['selected'];x=np.array(fit['x']);C=np.array(fit['root']);_,_,P,end,F=exact(np.array(fit['w']));cov=C@C.T
   dcov=L@np.linalg.solve(P,L.T)
   sw=v['SOC_width'];anchor=100*np.sqrt(F[0]@dcov@F[0]);candidate=100*np.sqrt(F[0]@cov@F[0])
   near('SOC_direct_same_anchor',anchor,sw['direct_same_anchor_SD_pp']);near('SOC_direct_transport',candidate,sw['direct_transport_SD_pp']);counts['SOC_scalar_checks']+=2
   trans={'direct_C':(end,F)}
   if name!='direct':
    endpoint,D=transported(fields[name],x);trans['compressed']=(endpoint,D)
    native=100*np.sqrt(D[0]@cov@D[0]);near('SOC_compressed',native,sw['compressed_transport_SD_pp']);near('SOC_ratio',native/anchor,sw['compressed_to_same_anchor_ratio']);counts['SOC_scalar_checks']+=2
   data[name]=(cov,trans)
  if p['fits']['arms']['direct']['status']=='converged':
   rcov,rtrans=data['direct'];rend,rF=rtrans['direct_C']
   for name,v in p['fits']['arms'].items():
    if v['status']!='converged':continue
    cov,trans=data[name]
    for fm in v['forecasts']:
     endpoint,D=trans[fm['transport']];future=future_tasks()[fm['task']]
     rv,rJ,_,_=model.evaluate(rend,future);vv,J,_,_=model.evaluate(endpoint,future)
     rK=rJ@rF;K=J@D
     rsd=np.sqrt(np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i',rK,rcov,rK));sd=np.sqrt(np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i',K,cov,K))
     delta=vv-rv
     near('forecast_RMS',1000*np.sqrt(np.mean(delta**2)),fm['RMS_difference_mV'])
     near('forecast_width_ratio',[min(sd/rsd),max(sd/rsd)],fm['local_SD_ratio_range']);counts['forecast_scalar_checks']+=3
probe=json.loads((root/'provenance/rc_sensitivity_basis_001/response_probe.json').read_text());reprobe=json.loads(Path('/tmp/rc-controls-review-r1-probe.json').read_text());assert probe==reprobe
result=dict(counts=counts,max_absolute_numeric_check_error=maxerr,statuses=statuses,response_probe_exact_repeat=True)
Path('/tmp/rc-controls-review-r1-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
reproduction.checker_note: Initial covariance-inversion checker tolerance 3e-10 relative/2e-10 absolute was tighter than differing inverse-versus-Cholesky arithmetic (first difference 4.85e-10 percentage points). Revised checker tolerance is 3e-7 relative/2e-9 absolute; observed largest SOC width difference is 1.94e-9 percentage points. Exact replay comparisons retain exact equality and were not relaxed.

limits: Independent rerun verifies reproducibility, not independent physical confirmation. The covariance check reuses physical model/transport derivatives and independently expands full covariance quadratic forms; it does not certify those derivatives over a physical family.
Prior P1/code review scopes remain conditional. No production/native campaign files were changed by this review.
Final root docs/handoff/receipt are outside scope; this review binds the exact candidate sources and result files above.
